goal: Test whether a fixed determinantal point-process style set objective built strictly from past marginal quality and co-occurrence-profile diversity can select top-8 pools with reproducible 5+ coverage beyond same-window frequency and exact matched random baselines.

nearestPriorFamilies.difference: Graph topology scores numbers individually; v322 optimizes the determinant of the entire 8-number set.
Gap-composition models ordered spacing; v322 uses a PSD Gram kernel of past co-occurrence profiles and a joint set determinant.

model.quality: q_n = max(1e-9, ((count_n + 1)/(window + 2)) / (6/49)); counts use only the frozen rolling window before target.
model.cooccurrenceProfile: For each n, feature_m=(cooccur(n,m)+1)/(count_n+49); the 49-vector is L2 normalized. cooccur uses only the same past rolling window.
model.gram: G_ij = dot(normalizedProfile_i, normalizedProfile_j), a PSD Gram matrix.
model.similarityKernel: S=(1-beta)I + beta*G, preserving PSD for beta in [0,1].
model.selection: Greedy 8-step MAP approximation: at each step add the number maximizing log(det(L_S + 1e-12 I)); ties by lower number. The algorithm and jitter are fixed before execution.
model.frequencyBaseline: Top 8 q_n from the same rolling window, ties by lower number.
